messages.subject: Project Mosaic - Series A term sheet for sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Priya,

Term sheet for the FairChain Series A attached for your sign-off. Headline terms as discussed: GBP 4,000,000 for 2,000,000 Series A preference shares at GBP 2.00, GBP 14m pre / GBP 18m post, leaving you at c.22.2% fully diluted. 1x non-participating liquidation preference, 12% enlarged option pool established pre-money, Investor Director seat (Daniel) plus a board observer, and the usual reserved-matters and information rights.

Binding provisions are 45-day exclusivity, confidentiality, and a GBP 30,000 costs cap. Target completion 30 September. If you're happy I'll send to Denham Lewis to get it signed this week.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Mosaic - Series A term sheet for sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Happy with the term sheet - go ahead and issue it. One steer for the documentation stage: this is a GBP 4m cheque, not a Lumen-sized one, so let's be pragmatic on the warranty package. I don't want to spend the fee budget grinding Denham Lewis on every limitation. Protect the headline economics and the board/control rights; be commercial on the rest.

Daniel

Daniel Reeve | Partner | Crestview Capital Partners
